prompts.title: Lord Krishna Blessing Boy AI Prompt
prompts.prompt: Canon camera 8k HDR low-angle dramatic portrait of a young man with black sunglasses, wearing a beige damask-patterned shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbows and high-waisted black pleated wide-leg trousers, standing with one hand in pocket. A divine blue hand, adorned with gold and red bangles, rudraksha bead strands, a gold ring, and draped red cloth with a pearl tassel, holds a carved wooden bansuri flute above him, with a peacock feather behind it. Flowing sheer red chiffon ribbons swirl dynamically around both the flute and the man, creating strong movement. Background of weathered ancient stone fort ruins in warm beige tones, golden dust particles floating in cinematic light. Face same as reference image. Aspect ratio 4:5.
prompts.description: Use this Janmashtami photo editing prompt to create a devotional portrait of a young man beneath Lord Krishna's blue hand holding a flute, at a fort backdrop.
